properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 declared at yarn.lock:11475 (`hash.js@1.1.7, hash.js@^1.0.0, hash.js@^1.0.3, hash.js@^1.1.7`), a transitive dependency of web3 (eth-lib) and of @ethersproject/sha2 via @uniswap/sdk. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 declared at yarn.lock:8899 — the workhorse ECDSA library of this stack: pulled transitively by web3 (eth-lib), by @uniswap/sdk → @ethersproject/signing-key (yarn.lock:2502), and by browserify-sign/crypto-browserify (react-scripts@4 browser polyfill). Signs on secp256k1 (Ethereum's curve); also provides ed25519 and ECDH in the shipped bundle. Shor-vulnerable signature (deadline risk, not harvest risk); replacement ML-DSA-65. The secp256k1 scheme is fixed by the Ethereum protocol —

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: browserify pbkdf2 polyfill (resolved 3.1.2), declared in TWO stanzas: yarn.lock:15192 (`pbkdf2@^3.0.17`) and yarn.lock:15203 (`pbkdf2@^3.0.3`). Consumed by web3-eth-accounts keystore encryption (yarn.lock:20380) and the crypto-browserify polyfill. PBKDF2 is quantum-resistant as a KDF primitive (Grover quadratic); the iteration count is chosen by the consumer and is not visible at the declaration. No direct call site in application code.

properties.value: selfsigned@1.10.8 declared at yarn.lock:18084.
